description: Les routes départementales du Nord (Route59 / cd59_route59/cd59_route59_201808/cd59_route59_2020) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The road network managed by the Northern Department. Since 1 January 2017, the data “Route59” excludes the roads included in the Métropole Européenne de Lille (MEL). (Locations: R:\catalogue\donesSIG\Reseaurouteferre\BaseVoiede.gdb\BaseVoie\Route59//N:\documentations and sources products\projectportal\dataandfile sde\prod\reference\reseauroutierferre@referenceprod.sde\reference.reseauroutierferre.cd59route59). Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "The departmental roads of the North (Route59/cd59_route59/cd59_route59_201808/cd59_route59_2020)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include voirie, nord, transport, voirie départementale, réseau routier, voirie routière. The listing shows 2021-05-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
